prompt: Review whether Bloom Energy has a material causal relationship to the solar, storage and grid-flexibility reset through dispatchable onsite generation; accept or reject the edge.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: Grid bottlenecks and variable renewable output can increase demand for firm onsite generation, allowing Bloom fuel cells to participate conditionally in a broader flexibility stack where rapid deployment has economic value.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject the edge if Bloom remains outside the material flexibility value chain or fuel, emissions, permitting, reliability and cost disadvantages prevent onsite fuel cells from complementing grids, solar and storage.
